problems: Cliopatria rows 'Grand Duchy of Würzburg' and 'Principality of Regensberg' carry each other's land (Regensberg shapes contain Würzburg; Würzburg 1806-1807 shapes lie round Aschaffenburg and the 1811-1814 shapes are the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt). grand-duchy-of-wurzburg points its corrections at the Regensberg row by Cliopatria name and principality-of-regensberg the reverse; the colour/compile agents must treat the pair together.

All eight Cliopatria shapes of Grand Duchy of Berg are in the wrong place (Hesse, Thuringia, France/Belgium); marked wrong with radius-region corrections; Berg ends November 1813 although the row runs to 1827.

grand-duchy-of-hesse, grand-duchy-of-saxe-weimar-eisenach end in 1871 (German Empire), the sibling convention, although both monarchies lasted to 1918; grand-duchy-of-wurzburg starts 26 December 1805, a year before Cliopatria's first shape (new keyframe).
No confidence-1 events: where the pages were silent the event was left out and listed under gaps.

Cross-dossier mismatches to reconcile: Weimar's Neustadt gain names kingdom-of-prussia (Saxony page: annexed by Prussia, re-ceded) while kingdom-of-saxony records its loss against Prussia; Hesse's Westphalia loss is 1815 (Prussia dossier agrees, 9 June 1815) but the Rhenish Hesse gain is 1816; kingdom-of-bavaria records a 1816-1819 gain from grand-duchy-of-hesse with no matching Hessian loss in this dossier.
